reserve_components_per_device.accounting_note: The 4 GiB reserve is a containing budget, so these terms are not added again to planned_total. RoPE is four BF16 [262144,64] caches (decode/prefill cos/sin); the page table is int32 [32,4096]. The TP4 physical-Ring sampler replaces the local uint32 [1,1,32,65536] index with four replicated global-index chunks of that shape (33,554,432 bytes total) plus [1,1,32,128] offsets; force argmax and stochastic sampling transiently gather BF16 [1,1,32,262144].

memory_capacity_plan.calculation_basis: All sizes include TT tile-format storage (1088 bytes per BFP8 tile). Full model weights add the BF16 replicated 248320x5120 embedding, BF16 replicated final norm, and TP4 BFP8 padded-262144 vocabulary head to the selected decoder stack. Cache and recurrent-state terms retain the selected paged-cache dtype split and batch-32 policy.
